integrity: The lower barrier is proved analytically for finite-support witnesses. The infinite geometric state is used only to compute a limiting lower bound via Fatou; every actual witness is a finite truncation. The bundled numerical checker corroborates, but does not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is a lower bound on the best universal coefficient, not an identification of that coefficient. It proves optimality only within the limiting truncated-geometric family and does not establish a dispersion coefficient or a sharp second-order coding theorem.
title: Thermal purifications force a \(1.295220\) lower barrier for balanced-loss information variance
